explanationMd: Any nonzero number to power zero equals one. A negative first power is a reciprocal, so 5⁻¹ = 1/5. Adding gives 1 + 1/5 = 6/5.

distractorRationale.b: This omits the term 5⁰, which equals one.
distractorRationale.a: A zero exponent does not make a nonzero base equal zero.
distractorRationale.c: This treats both terms as reciprocals of five.
